manifest.source: Pinned darwin-arm64 Claude Code 2.1.226 census plus a reviewed snapshot of Anthropic's official hook reference.

detection.notes: Pinned binary probes are digest-bound under packages/surface/vendors/claude/probes/claude@2.1.226; missing flags still degrade observation with warnings.

argv.notes: --session-id establishes new identity; --resume continues an existing identity and is never combined with --session-id.

hook.notes: Loopback HTTP bridge with bearer interpolation; SessionStart and Setup use the command forwarder because Claude 2.1.226 does not support HTTP for them.

transcript.notes: Durable JSONL is authoritative for message content; hook events remain authoritative for lifecycle.

statusline.notes: Claude invokes the configured statusLine command with usage and rate-limit JSON on stdin.

subagentStatusLine.notes: Claude invokes the configured child command with the currently visible task snapshot on stdin. Rolling tokenSamples omit timestamps, so consumers must use callback-time tokenCount for rate samples.

terminal.notes: Native TUI control only; semantic state is never parsed from terminal rendering.

claims.harness: Authentication-independent isolated --init-only and print-mode census in packages/surface/vendors/claude/census/harness.mjs
Exact artifact --version, --help, SHA-256, and bounded status-channel source probe in packages/surface/vendors/claude/census/generate-model.mjs

claims.notes: Digest-pinned review of https://code.claude.com/docs/en/hooks retrieved for the v2.1.226 adaptation. Documentation proves declared support, not execution on the pinned artifact.

limitations: Artifact integrity and controlled runtime captures currently cover only darwin-arm64; protected promotion still requires every configured platform.

The isolated baseline deliberately uses no credentials. The child status payload is statically verified in the pinned artifact, but its runtime invocation and hook-based tool, permission, delegation, compaction, worktree, and MCP paths remain uncaptured.
The official hook reference is mutable. Its reviewed summary is digest-pinned here, and a future candidate must repeat the review and census rather than inheriting this claim.
